RE: Account reference: ACC-757629

Dear Ms. Lee,

Receiving your dispute regarding the account ACC-757629, we acknowledge your assertion that you are not responsible for the debt. We understand that you have been receiving communications from our office regarding this account.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to investigate your dispute. We will review the account history and verify the ownership of the debt. As per our records, the original creditor for this account is Apex Auto Finance. The account was charged off on November 3, 2023.

We will investigate the status of the debt and provide you with a response regarding the ownership and validity of the debt. If we determine that the debt is not collectible, we will cease all collection activities. However, if our investigation confirms that the debt is valid and collectible, we will provide you with a validation notice as required by the FDCPA.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe that our investigation does not accurately reflect the facts. You may request a written validation of the debt, which will include the amount of the debt, the creditor's name, and a statement that upon your request, the creditor will provide you with the name and address of the original creditor.

We will notify you of the outcome of our investigation and take any necessary actions.

Sincerely,

Vanguard Debt Services
